Based on our previous Hawaii vacation planning document, here is a suggested packing list for your trip:

**Essentials:
• Passport
• Plane ticket
• Travel insurance
• Driver’s license
• Credit cards
• Debit card
• Cash

**Clothing:
• 3-4 tops/shirts
• 2-3 pairs shorts/pants
• 1-2 light jackets
• 1-2 swimsuits
• 1-2 dresses
• Undergarments
• Socks
• Comfortable walking shoes
• Sandals
• Dress shoes
• Light jacket

**Beach Essentials:
• Large and small towels
• Beach bag
• Sunscreen
• Sunglasses
• Water bottle
• Beach umbrella
• Beach chairs
• Snorkeling gear
• Water shoes

**Toiletries:
• Toothbrush
• Toothpaste
• Deodorant
• Shampoo
• Conditioner
• Soap
• Razor
• Hairbrush
• Contact lenses/glasses

**Electronics:
• Phone
• Laptop
• Camera
• Portable charger
• Power bank
• Universal adapter
• Waterproof phone case
• Camera housing

**Miscellaneous:
• Reusable straw
• Collapsible cooler
• Snacks
• Water purification tablets
• Insect repellent
• First aid kit
• Travel adapter
• Travel pillow
• Earplugs
• Eye mask
• Guidebook
• Map
• Beach reading
• Entertainment for downtime

**Hawaii Specific:
• Light rain jacket
• Swim goggles
• Beach bag with waterproof lining
• Reef-safe sunscreen
• Beach umbrella with sturdy base
• Water shoes with good grip
• Snorkeling gear for specific locations
• Hawaiian-style clothing

**Additional Tips:
• Check weather forecast before departure
• Pack light and versatile clothing
• Bring a small daypack for island hopping
• Consider packing clothes that can be easily mixed and matched
• Don’t forget to leave some extra space in your luggage for souvenirs!
